changes.summary: AgentZap's public pricing page changed from per-call bundles to per-minute bundles. The day the page switched is not known. This entry compares the 14 February 2026 archive with the pricing page recorded in the cost model on 6 November 2026.
changes.before: Archive of agentzap.ai/pricing on 14 February 2026: Starter $79/month for 50 calls, then $2.00/call; Basic $199/month for 150 calls, then $1.80/call; Pro $499/month for 500 calls, then $1.50/call; Enterprise custom. That page said 24/7 answering and appointment scheduling were included.
changes.after: Pricing page checked 6 November 2026 and stored in src/data/cost-models.json: Starter $109/month for 150 minutes, then $0.85/min, plus a $499 setup fee; Professional $295/month for 450 minutes, then $0.75/min, plus $499 setup; Business $899/month for 1,500 minutes, then $0.70/min, plus $499 setup; Managed $899/month for 1,500 minutes with setup included and no overage rate printed; Enterprise custom. The unit is minutes, not calls.

sources.title: agentzap.ai/pricing as recorded in the cost model

changes.summary: OnCrew's public pricing changed from per-call bundles to per-minute bundles. OnCrew told us the move happened in late October 2026. This entry compares the listing we had recorded on 4 November 2026 with oncrew.ai/pricing checked on 12 November 2026.
changes.before: Listing recorded 4 November 2026 from a third-party roundup: Starter $49/mo (100 calls); Pro $149; Multi-Truck $349. Billing model: per answered call.
changes.after: Pricing page checked 12 November 2026: Starter $49/mo with 150 minutes of answered calls, then $0.49 per extra minute; Pro $149/mo with 200 minutes, then $0.99 per extra minute; Multi-Truck $349/mo with 500 minutes, then $0.99 per extra minute. No setup fee. 14-day free trial with no card required.
